detail: mapping shared-component usages across Angular routes and templates

content.text:
I wrote `answers.json` in the workspace root. `tentRoutes` has 32 routes, `rationRoutes` has 21, `helmetRoutes` has `germania/archive` and `syria/archive`, and `unroutedComponents` has 8 classes. I haven't hand-checked individual routes beyond the totals.

I built the component graph from `ng-facts` usages for every selector, then walked it from each route's page. For `reports`, I treated the child pages (`daily`, `losses`) as the routes, including the parent page's contents. No parent page shows tent, ration or helmet itself.

The unrouted components are the six province archive pages (britannia, aegyptus, graecia, dacia, gallia, hispania), `OldDashboardPageComponent`, and `EagleComponent`.
